description: Permissions only the main window needs. Separate from the default capability because a capability's `windows` list applies to every permission in it, so folding this in would also hand the pinned-note popover a file dialog it never opens. Choosing the Index folder is the one thing here: the dialog plugin is registered in Rust, but a plugin being registered does not grant the frontend the right to call it, and without this the picker was denied at runtime and the Change Index button silently did nothing.
